![Monthly revenue bar chart, 2026](/tmp/claude-501/plots/monthly_revenue.png)

Revenue grows from $41,200 in January to $71,800 in December. The only dips are February, June and October. I labeled just the first and highest bars. The chart is a single series in one blue, so it has no legend.

The CSV has a December row, but today is Nov 28, 2026. That figure is probably a forecast or placeholder, so check it before you use the chart. Excluding December would make November ($66,300) the latest actual month.

I saved the image at `/tmp/claude-501/plots/monthly_revenue.png` and the script at `/tmp/claude-501/plots/plot.py`. Both are outside the repo, so nothing in the project changed. If you want the chart in the repo, tell me where to put it.
